experiment: K15 background x fixed gain missing cell

statistics.unit: physical snapshot; both goals resampled together

protocol.experiment: K15 missing cell: new common background plus fixed amplification of the adapted model's own instruction response

conditions.new_gain: mu_new + alpha*(v_new(actual q)-mu_new); no old-model output used to produce the velocity
conditions.old_gain: mu_old + alpha*(v_new(actual q)-mu_new); exact replication of K14 S5 canonical corrected group
conditions.native: adapted native actual-q policy; exact replication of K14 A_nat

protocol.queries: means from canonical Left/Right, actual q separately forwarded, same current observation/draft/time; never choose +/- by target
protocol.action_dimensions: formula applied to all 32 denoising dimensions, matching K14 S5; only first7 physical dimensions executed
protocol.snapshots: same 20 K14 saved Front-prefix stable-grasp common snapshots, exact full boundary signature
protocol.timing: 60 control steps from saved boundary; after window adapted native same q to absolute400
protocol.noise_and_refresh: unchanged K14 snapshot seed, global replan index, execute10 then refresh observation
protocol.analysis: paired comparisons by physical snapshot, 10000 bootstrap resamples over20 snapshots, 95% interval; retain per-instruction counts
protocol.comparison_rules: report new_gain-native and new_gain-old_gain; use delta0.15 and CI lower>0 as K14 clearly-better descriptive rule; point difference<=0.10 is descriptive closeness only, NOT equivalence
protocol.interpretation_limits: development states; alpha fixed, no tuning if failed; cannot generalize to every gain, other tasks or semantic understanding
protocol.baseline_audit: native and old_gain must reproduce archived K14 per-episode outcomes AND complete400-step traces; investigate mismatch before attributing new results
